# Live-n-Comfort

> A gift shop on Main Street in the Village of Jeffersonville, in the town of Cambridge, Vermont, open since December 2019.

## What's on the shelves

- Handmade artisan goods: ceramics, teas, bags and totes
- Stationery: cards, calendars and journals
- Organic linens
- Seasonal gifts

## Visit

- Address: 143 Main Street, Jeffersonville, VT 05464
- Hours: Wednesday to Saturday 11 am to 4 pm; Sunday 10 am to 3 pm; Monday and Tuesday closed
- Holiday and seasonal hours are posted on Instagram and Facebook.
- There is no online shop yet. Online shopping is coming soon.
